items.title: Shortlist banao
items.detail: Dream, target aur safe, teeno type ki universities. Sirf naam pe mat jao, course dekho.

items.title: Test date book karo
items.detail: IELTS, TOEFL ya PTE, jo bhi chahiye. Ek retake ka time bhi haath mein rakho.

items.title: SOP ka pehla draft
items.detail: Apni kahani likho, resume mat dohrao. Pehla draft rough hoga, chalega.

items.title: LOR ke liye pehle poocho
items.detail: Professor ya manager ko kaafi pehle bolo. Last minute pe sab busy hote hain.

youtube.title: Abroad jaana hai? Ye 4 cheezein abhi shuru karo
youtube.description:
Next year abroad padhne ka plan hai? Ye 4 cheezein abhi se shuru karo: shortlist, test date, SOP ka pehla draft, aur LOR ke liye pehle se poochna.

Jaldi shuru karoge toh last minute ki tension nahi hogi.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. Contact aap karoge, hum nahi.
